notes.title: New Baby Duka Game About To Launch On Steam! (trailer)
notes.notes:
Hi all followers and Baby Duka fans :urbansocial: Today I'm proud to announce the launch of a new teaser for my current production: DASH - a 2D platformer creation tool for creative and competitive players. In the colorful and sometimes far our style of Baby Duka. Custom physics built for solid control (speedruns), and an atmospheric editor which will feel like your second home after a while. I'm very excited to share more content and news with you once the game's store page is ready. I'm aiming to reveal the Steam presence of DASH late July/August 2018! It's going to be a 100% community-driven experience with a program designed for UGC, the Workshop and free monthly updates with new heroes, blocksets, game modes and much much more.

notes.title: New Baby Duka Game & Urban Pirate's 2 Year Anniversary
notes.notes:
[h1]2 YEARS SINCE THE RELEASE OF URBAN PIRATE[/h1]

Mid June 2016 the crime simulator 'Urban Pirate' was launched on Steam and around 500 pirates had themselves an urban adventure. That's about two years ago and for that reason we're practically giving the grimy game away - [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/471380/Urban_Pirate/]it's 75% off (1,50€) in the store[/url][/b] until 5th of July.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/57be5ca3f26e1885685bf2af4bb504c5dc653ffe.png[/img]

The game was the first to be produced entirely by Baby Duka and was self-funded. The Copenhagen-based audio producer B Magic Samples delivered an original and fresh pack of sounds and songs.

The game was later ported to Linux.

October 2016 Urban Pirate was nominated Best Idea at the VII Annual Independent Games Festival in Bilbao.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/bdea876d41c6fcd599fac869443ab970802d3f03.gif[/img]

Two years after the release over 6000 units have been activated on Steam (though only 17 reviews...), at least 60 people have completed the merciless and almost impossible 90s VGA-like game, 1 person made a guide, and over 100 gameplay vids are uploaded.

Here's the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MKp4fSHwv3A&list=PLNXqXxmRUGgqQibfKl3aEDt-NKkavEMcl]ultimate playlist[/url] if you want to hang out and watch some urban crime. :urbanhappy::urbanspraycan:

[h1]DASH - Danger Action Speed Heroes NEW Game By Baby Duka[/h1]

Since December 2017 Baby Duka has been busy working on a prototype of a new game. And not just any game. I won't say more here, but I advice you [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/d-a-s-h-danger-action-speed-hero]check out the DASHlog[/url]. Here all the development is documented and shared. This is especially for you who find the development exciting.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/9ac425fb1fe60928754cfe9925e567501690e30a.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/dfa482c4e5b164ac0d04686bdcdf11feeecee9d8.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/62946a05f5310d36e32a776a0edd95a429e6082d.gif[/img]

And I can say as much as it's another colorful and edgy world we're about to witness.

Baby Duka is streaming the content from the latest build [url=https://www.twitch.tv/BabyDuka]every Saturday on Twitch[/url].

Urban Pirates Celebrate 1 Year Anniversary June 16 & 17
notes.notes:
On June 17th (June 18th PST) the grimy, petty crime sim launched on Steam after being on Greenlight for about 5 weeks, and 10 months of intense development. A terrifying yet extremely exciting episode in the history of Baby Duka Games, and here we are one year later.

Baby Duka, the artist and developer behind UP, has made this childish, and naïve peace to give the game a fresh capsule for its birthday ːurbanhappyːːurbanspraycanː

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/93cb9242821f13576ce4305d3c001a13de46a1e1.png[/img]

We will be broadcasting some cool vids during today and tomorrow, showing cool tricks, and some behind-the-game goodies. Also we will be talking a bit about the future, so stay put.

If you're new to the game, welcome ːurbansocialː There is more to the streets than it seems.

notes.title: Get Streetwise in Urban Pirate
notes.notes:
Sheep Island is a rough and tumble kind of place, riddled with corruption, serial killers, and the general chaos plaguing the modern world. You’re plain sick of it, to be honest, so do you engage in peaceful protest? Write to your government representative? Nay. It’s time to take to the streets, raid some dumpsters, and do some neat tricks on your skateboard. This is Urban Pirate [official site], and it is all about shoplifting, and spray-painting, and living life on the edge because SOCIETY, man.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: You Won't Make It Alone, Pirate!
notes.notes:
[b]Even though it might be tempting to play Urban Pirate as a single-player game, and go through the tough struggle it is, to rise from a petty thief to an urban pirate[/b], this game has a meta structure of street-smart guides which can help you, change your style, or perhaps inspire you to change your direction.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/2ec647f3137d061cdea20832a00f4cd9b7fa2296.gif[/img]
[i]@ADHDan on YouTube[/i]

Back when the urban pirates were just starting to appear, we saw YouTubers who shared their experience in order to show off their skills and have a laugh while playing a game in development. This quickly helped both us on the developing side but also fellow players who could see that several aspects of the game could be played in various ways (e.g. skating the streets and making some nice combos seemed at first incomprehensible for one player ːurbaninsaneː but after watching another player's video he got inspired to skate in new way).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/961563cf9b134f263a0326f77b3599b88510bd96.gif[/img]
[i]@Grandpuh Ty "Lean 2 Skate" on YouTube[/i]

Later when the final game was launched a fellow pirate had trouble escaping the store detective - simply because she hadn't thought of jumping over those benches and banana peels. This was her reply:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/a2248c9b9b931e0fedc34795c57c157d6d389e9d.jpg[/img]

And she was right. She did what any true pirate would do: watch, learn and RUN AS FAST AS YOU CAN ːurbanhappyːːurbanhappyː Eventually Tiff got it and she may be the first pirate to show off her jetpack, some painted trains or a disguise kit? Life as an urban pirate is unpredictable ːurbanspraycanː

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/9ded103864bfbc8f61e48f54cf04bcd1854ceab6.gif[/img]
[i]@tiffplays on YouTube[/i]

Rencently Funky Fred started his [i]Comprehensive Guide For Hating Yourself/Playing Urban Pirates[/i] which is great fun, especially if you remember reading those old gaming magazines that had walkthroughs and cheats! You should [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/471380] check it out.[/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/d2ed960125832a8b2d45991dfb6b02c1e5934e76.jpg[/img]

We believe that this community of urban pirates who share knowledge and experiences is the best way to exprience the whole game, for us, the devs, but also for the players. The guide included in the game is just a template of inspiration on how to survive and become more than a petty thief. When we were kids we used to learn from our friends, siblings, cousins, uncle and aunts when we were screwed in a game and needed some inspiration on how to tackle the levels. There was no www or Let's Plays. Now we have the whole world. A whole world of urban pirates who will slowly start showing off weed farms, 360 flips, whole-cars and a city on fire.

A BIG shoutout to all you street rats and slum lords who made it through the tough beginning and posted videos! A world of sun, cold drinks and hammocks awaits you! ːurbanhappyːːdirtymoneyː

ːurbansocialːKeep sharing and showing off ːurbansocialː

Ahoy!

notes.title: Update 3.0.0.1 Born For Shoplifting
notes.notes:
Fellow pirates!!

[b]We fixed the upgrade 'Born For Shoplifting' so that you actually get the upgrade, and a few other things that was bugging.[/b]

Some of you might receive an ERROR message when launching your awesome and unique save-game... This is, of course, something that could cause mutiny and pissed off pirates, we know that... But we figured you would rather want a full game with the upgrades right rather than the previous version where 'Born For Shoplifting' didn't get activated?

If you're working on a Let's Play and find it unreasonable to continue (in case you get the ERROR message and have to start over) we suggest you think twice. Remember that Urban Pirate is non-linear and you might just benefit from giving the first levels another go. If you're busy documenting the very last levels and your score is insane, all we can say is... arrrghhh!!!!

notes.title: So You're New Here, kid...
notes.notes:
Welcome to the release of Urban Pirate for Windows!

Much has happened since the alpha and beta demos came out late 2015.

Lots of new features, tunes and mechanics.

Urban Pirate started as an experiment and has come a long way and is now a little adventure... Make sure to tell your side of the story in the forum or in the Workshop. Come up with new skills, equipment and characters.

Let's build the urban pirate paradise, let's take control of our own lifes!!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25277363/13b4ecb08be13b4519897adf4b45b2e7a43ad987.gif[/img]
